needed.evidence: Footway is narrow and under 1m, effectively restricting pedestrian usability
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, wider sidewalk or separate the footway from the carriageway with a physical barrier.

needed.evidence: Footway is partially obstructed by bins and structures
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footway is unblocked and clearly demarcated from the carriageway.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out the uneven sections of the footway to eliminate tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: Tripping hazards present on narrow footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway surface to remove any obstacles and tripping hazards.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing the carriageway without marked crossings or refuges
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with adequate refuge space for safe crossing of the road.
